name: civicbridge-firebase-rules-tests
description: Runs firebase/firestore.rules and firebase/storage.rules against the local Firebase emulators. Separate from the app's own package.json so the app does not depend on firebase-tools.

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project civicbridge-rules-test --config ../firebase.json "node --test --test-concurrency=1 firestore-rules.test.mjs storage-rules.test.mjs cloud-records.test.mjs token-flow.test.mjs"
